Development of technological processes in tree care - changing view of care for urban forest. (allowance 2/2)
Environmental requirements for trees, possibilities of modification of habitat conditions of mature trees. (allowance 2/2)
Selection of plant material for planting nurseries decorative woody plants. (allowance 2/2)
Urban tree planting I. -- technological process of tree planting. (allowance 2/2)
Urban tree planting II. - technological process of replanting tree . (allowance 2/2)
